An investigator would have to redo some analysis.","problems":["Claims that the 'code mix is also heavily weighted toward 99214' so the pattern looks like a 'provider-wide habit' is not supported by the card, which has no peer 99214 comparison; 216/320 at 99214 is stated without a benchmark.","'Several times the all-provider rate' is vague; the card gives specific rates (0.155 vs 0.02, 0.134 vs 0.034) that were not cited.","Uses the word 'habit' and 'billing profile itself is the concern', which is stronger than the evidence given the inconclusive leaning and z of 2.15.","Says 'three on low-complexity patients (C0019746, C0019925, C0020005)'; this is correct per the card, but the fourth documented claim C0019786 is not in the sampled lists, so its complexity cannot be verified.","Narrative says to request records for sampled low-complexity 99215s, yet the formal next_steps only say to request a larger generic sample and re-screen; no specific claim IDs listed there, so the next steps are vague.","Cited_claim_ids list only C0019739 and C0019746, while the text cites other claims (C0019775, C0019751, C0019807, C0019925, C0020005) as support, so citations are inconsistent.","Does not mention that only 2 of 52 99215 claims are on high-complexity patients, nor the 99215 peer-comparison documentation rate of 0 for context (the 'comparison providers 0%' point is weak since all-provider 99215 rate is 0 too)."]}
